# Jason Wang (Weifeng Wang)

> Computer Science & Cognitive Psychology Researcher | Co-founder & Lead AI Engineer at Certiferox | CPS112 Lab Assistant at Franklin & Marshall College

Jason Wang (Weifeng Wang / 王尉锋) is a researcher and software engineer operating at the convergence of artificial intelligence, human cognitive modeling, and sustainable web architecture. His research and engineering explore high-dimensional algorithmic systems (PyTorch, RAGs, agent architectures) anchored in behavioral psychology, cognitive workload constraints, and digital sustainability (< 0.015g CO2/view).

## Academic & Engineering Focus
- **Computer Science**: Machine Learning, Artificial Neural Networks, AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), High-Performance Computing, Algorithm Design, Java & Python Systems.
- **Cognitive Psychology**: Behavioral Modeling, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Causal Inference, Cognitive Workload Reduction, AI Ethics & Moral Philosophy.
- **Digital Sustainability**: Strict SWDM v4 Carbon Auditing (< 0.015g CO2/view), Green Hosting, Zero-Tracker Architecture, GDPR Exemption by Design.

  - Led weekly peer problem-solving groups focusing on Python, algorithms, and contest mathematics.
